Settings

Other

notes.title: Short Announcement
notes.content:
Sorry for the sporadic updates and currently broken ramps in the game,
The main reason is personal issues that I'm happy to say I'm making good progress with.
The second reason is my PC's RAM is starting to fail to the point of it needing replacement before I can continue work on the game.

Progress will pick up now that the year has begun (once my RAM stops bluescreening),
and an update will come out shortly to make the game playable again.

- Limebat Games
